working_definition: Author type 'LPC1' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that develops from an optic neuroblast and will become an adult optic lobe neuron.

justification: 'LPC1' is FBbt:00111767 'lobula plate columnar neuron LPC1', which has no immature form in FBbt; at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so the most specific ancestor with an immature form is used: FBbt:00053539 'immature adult optic lobe neuron' (as for Kurmangaliyev 2020 early clusters).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Lobula plate columnar neuron that has its main dendritic arborization in lobula plate layer 2 and receives input from T4b and T5b neurons (Shinomiya et al., 2022). It projects to a small glomerulus in the posterior region of the optic glomeruli of the PVLP, posterior to LC4 and ventral to LPLC3. It is cholinergic (Davis et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form, used from the pharate adult stage; no immature form in FBbt.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053539 'immature adult optic lobe neuron' (broad match).
